frozen_gates_from_specification.SR-2_engine_gate: Stage-1 EXP-DREG-001 anchor ranks (69,073 at n=15; 143,882 at n=18; t=3, D=5, seed 2026, ti=0) reproduced exactly by BOTH rank arms, and both arms agree on the calibration matrices; else O-ENGINE-FAIL and stop before Stage 2.
frozen_gates_from_specification.SR-3_baseline_gate: Stage-1 (40,2,2,20) smoke: SOLV4 failure rate > 0.10 in either stratum -> O-BASELINE-FAIL and stop before claiming Stage 2.
frozen_gates_from_specification.SR-4_dual_rank: Any dual-rank disagreement (dim R_4, closure rounds, or per-round low-space digest) or s mismatch on an instance -> that cell is O-ARTIFACT; never averaged.
frozen_gates_from_specification.SR-5_null: Null arm 'matches' primary failure rate at a decisive cell -> O-NULL-COLLAPSE for that cell's Assumption-1 reading (operationalization OP-NULL below).
frozen_gates_from_specification.SR-6_offdiagonal: Off-diagonal gate cannot separate diagonal from k-excess at any n -> O-CEILING (operationalization OP-SEP below).
frozen_gates_from_specification.SR-7_censoring: Cap exceeded -> O-CENSORED for that instance/cell; never a degree observation.
frozen_gates_from_specification.SR-8_infra: Budget abort / crash -> failed_infrastructure / O-IMPEDIMENT; never negative evidence.

sample_targets.stage1_smoke: 8 SAT + 8 UNSAT primary instances at (40,2,2,20) (>= 8 seeds; 8 per stratum so that 'both arms' holds under either reading of 'arm')
sample_targets.stage2: 100 SAT + 100 UNSAT primary instances and 100 null instances per decisive cell (spec: >= 100 per arm), reduced with a recorded shortfall when the session budget or a cap prevents it; never invented
sample_targets.stage3_offdiagonal: 50 SAT + 50 UNSAT primary instances per cell (spec: >= 50 per arm where affordable), shortfall recorded

executor_operationalizations.status: Executor operationalizations of clauses the frozen contract leaves open. Pre-registered here BEFORE any Stage-1 output, recorded as protocol interpretations in implementation/implementation.md, and submitted for Coordinator ratification. If the Coordinator reads any differently, results are re-derived from raw records under an amendment; nothing here edits the frozen contract.
executor_operationalizations.OP-ARM: 'Arm' in 'both arms' / 'per arm' / 'satisfiable arm' is read as the satisfiability stratum (SAT: s > 0; UNSAT: s = 0) of the primary instances; the null arm is a separate control arm, itself stratified by its own exact s. Dual GF(2) rank is computed on every instance regardless, so the computation is identical under the alternative reading (arm = rank routine).
executor_operationalizations.OP-INSTANCE: Primary instance at (n,m,t,k): F_{2^n} = F_2[x]/(f) with f the minimal-weight irreducible of degree n (lexicographically smallest trinomial x^n + x^a + 1, smallest a; else smallest pentanomial x^n + x^a + x^b + x^c + 1 by (a,b,c) lexicographic, a>b>c>0) -- Semaev's 'sparse f'; V = span_F2(1, alpha, ..., alpha^{k-1}) (Semaev's preferred V); curve Y^2 + XY = X^3 + A X^2 + B with B uniform nonzero in F_{2^n} per instance (Table 2 'random B'); A = 1 (S_3 does not involve A; A enters only point-arithmetic s via the curve, and the point-arithmetic method works on E or its quadratic twist); target z uniform in F_{2^n} per instance (Section 4.5.1 'random element z'). Instance i at cell c, arm a, stage s uses random.Random(int(sha256('EXP-SEMBIN-35bf67|'+s+'|'+c+'|'+a+'|'+str(i)).hexdigest()[:16], 16)); draw order: B (getrandbits(n) until nonzero), then z (getrandbits(n)).
executor_operationalizations.OP-SYSTEM: t = 2: S_3(x1, x2, z) = 0 with x1, x2 in V (N = 2k, n quadratic equations). t = 3: S_3(u1, x1, x2) = 0 and S_3(u1, x3, z) = 0 with u1 in F_{2^n}, x_i in V (N = n + 3k; n cubic + n quadratic). Coordinates of each equation on basis 1, alpha, ..., alpha^{n-1}; variables ordered u1_0..u1_{n-1}, x1_0..x1_{k-1}, x2_..., x3_...; Boolean ring (x^2 = x, field equations implicit). Zero coordinate equations are dropped and recorded.
executor_operationalizations.OP-S: s = exact number of Boolean solutions of the descended system = number of tuples (u, x_1..x_t) with x_i in V satisfying eq. (5). Method S-A (enumeration over V via S_3): t=2: for each x1 in V solve S_3(x1, X, z) = 0 for X in F_{2^n} (quadratic; trace/half-trace) and count roots in V; t=3: for each (x1,x2) in V^2 solve S_3(X, x1, x2) = 0 for u1, then S_3(u1, X, z) = 0 for x3 in V. Method S-B (point arithmetic on E): lift x-coordinates to points on E over F_{2^n} or F_{2^{2n}} and form x(P +- Q) by the group law; count tuples as in S-A. S-A and S-B are separate code and must agree on every instance; at N <= 30 a third method S-C (exhaustive Boolean evaluation of the descended system) is also run. Neither method reads any rank output.
executor_operationalizations.OP-R4: R_4 = the smallest F_2-subspace W of B_{<=4} that contains every m*f (f a descended generator, m a squarefree monomial with deg m <= 4 - deg f) and is closed under g in W, deg g <= 3, x a variable => x*g in W (Boolean product). This is the fixpoint of 449d2b C2 ('whenever a polynomial of degree d < 4 appears, re-admit its multiples up to degree 4; iterate to a fixed point'); multiplying by monomials of degree <= 4-d and iterating variable products give the same fixpoint. Columns ordered by degree descending (deg 4 first, then 3, 2, 1, 0), so the RREF rows whose pivot has degree <= 3 span W n B_{<=3}. Round 0 = initial Macaulay rows; round r+1 = x*g for all variables x and all RREF low rows g at the end of round r whose pivot is new since round r-1. closure_round_count = number of product rounds that increased rank (0 if the Macaulay matrix is already closed).
executor_operationalizations.OP-SOLV4: SOLV4 holds iff dim R_4 = M_le4 - s (exact per-instance s). Early stop (sound, recorded per instance): with pts the S-A solution tuples verified to satisfy every descended equation and rE = rank of the evaluation map B_{<=4} -> F_2^{|pts|}, W is a subspace of I(V(I)) n B_{<=4} whose dimension is <= M_le4 - rE; if rank(W) reaches M_le4 - rE the closure is at its fixpoint and the computation stops. SOLV4 then holds iff rE = s (rE recorded). If the rank never reaches that value the closure runs to the true fixpoint (no low pivots new in a round) and NOT SOLV4 is reported with exact dim R_4.
executor_operationalizations.OP-DUAL: Arm A: M4RI release-20240729 (git d0a1ee18), built from source (not apt 0.0.20200125, per DEC-20261005-c83e5a N2), used for mzd_addmul and mzd_echelonize_pluq. Arm B: executor-written C GF(2) elimination (Gray-code four-Russians product + plain Gaussian elimination), no M4RI code. Each arm runs its own closure from the identical generator file; because the RREF of a subspace is unique, both arms must produce identical rank after every chunk, identical low-space digests per round, identical dim R_4 and round count. Any difference -> O-ARTIFACT for the cell (SR-4).
executor_operationalizations.OP-NULL: Null instance i at a cell = T11 boolean_null (src/h012_peel_rank.py logic: per equation, the same number of monomials of each degree, monomials drawn uniformly without repetition) applied to the descended system of primary instance i, rng from OP-INSTANCE with arm 'null'. Its s is computed by exhaustive Boolean evaluation (S-C) only, which is feasible for N <= 42; null cells with N > 42 are recorded O-CENSORED for the null arm (s not computable in budget). 'Null matches primary' at a decisive cell iff, for every primary stratum with >= 10 instances and the null instances of the same satisfiability class with >= 10 instances, the two-sided Fisher exact test of the failure counts gives p >= 0.05.
executor_operationalizations.OP-SEP: The off-diagonal gate separates diagonal (n, m, t, ceil(n/m)) from k-excess (n, m, t, ceil(n/m)+j) iff in at least one stratum with >= 10 instances in both cells the two-sided Fisher exact test of SOLV4 failure counts gives p < 0.05. O-CEILING iff no executed off-diagonal cell separates.
executor_operationalizations.OP-KOSTERS: O-KOSTERS-NOREPRO iff at (45,2,2,23) >= 100 SAT and >= 100 UNSAT primary instances all have SOLV4 holding with dual-rank agreement.
executor_operationalizations.OP-CAPS: 8 GiB / 8 CPU-hours are applied per instance-arm process (RSS watchdog kill at 8 GiB, RLIMIT_CPU 28800 s); an instance exceeding either is O-CENSORED. Aggregate CPU-seconds per cell are also recorded so the per-cell reading of the cap can be applied by a reviewer. The handoff's 86400 s wall budget is a session-level budget (advisory under the 2026-09-06 research budget policy); counts not reached are a recorded shortfall.
executor_operationalizations.OP-STATS: Per cell, per stratum: failure count / n with Clopper-Pearson exact 95% interval and percentile bootstrap 95% interval (10,000 resamples, numpy-free Python random.Random(20261005)). SAT and UNSAT are never pooled.
executor_operationalizations.OP-ORDER: Within a cell, primary instances i = 0,1,2,... are generated and classified by S-A/S-B; SOLV4 runs alternate between the next unrun SAT instance and the next unrun UNSAT instance until each stratum reaches its target or the budget ends; generated-but-unrun indices are recorded.
executor_operationalizations.OP-LABEL: Exactly one primary O-* label, applied mechanically in this precedence: (1) O-ENGINE-FAIL if SR-2 fails; (2) O-BASELINE-FAIL if SR-3 smoke fails or the Stage-2 (40,2,2,20) rate exceeds 0.10 in either stratum; (3) O-ARTIFACT if any Stage-2 cell is invalidated by SR-4 or an s mismatch; (4) O-NULL-COLLAPSE if OP-NULL 'matches' at (40,2,2,20); (5) O-CEILING if OP-SEP fails on all executed off-diagonal cells; (6) O-KOSTERS-NOREPRO if OP-KOSTERS holds; (7) O-C1-N-AXIS / O-SURFACE-N / O-SURFACE-K only if the dphi/dk and fixed-k criteria are evaluable; (8) otherwise O-IMPEDIMENT if any undeterminable criterion is undeterminable because of a specification gap, missing tool or infrastructure failure, else O-CENSORED if only resource caps prevented it. Secondary labels (e.g. per-cell O-CENSORED, O-NULL-COLLAPSE at other cells) are listed separately and are not the primary label.

specification_gaps.clause: specification.yaml scope.included Stage 3: "fixed-k ladders k=4 (n=13..28) and k=7 (n=19..30) as far as budget"
specification_gaps.gap: Neither (m, t) is stated. independent_variables restrict arity_m and chain_t to {2, 3}, while Semaev's k=4 ladder rows (Tables 1-2, n=13..16) are m=t=4. The k=4 ladder therefore has at least two incompatible readings (m=t=3: N=n+12; m=t=4: N=2n+16, outside the frozen m levels).
specification_gaps.executor_action: Ladders not run; recorded in stage3/shortfall.json; Coordinator amendment requested.

specification_gaps.clause: primary_metrics d_phi_dk 'Fitted increase in certified-insufficient degree per unit k' and d_phi_dn; prediction 'distinguishable from 0 at 90% level'
specification_gaps.gap: No model, estimator, response variable or interval method is specified. A degree-4-only certificate yields a binary per-instance observable (degree 4 insufficient / degree 4 sufficed); converting failure rates into a degree increment requires a model the contract does not give.
specification_gaps.executor_action: Per-cell failure rates on the m=2 diagonal cells (k = 15, 20, 23, 25) are reported raw with intervals; no fit is computed; amendment requested.

specification_gaps.clause: controls null_arm / falsification 'null arm matches primary failure rate'; off_diagonal_gate 'certificate must separate diagonal from k-excess'; success_criterion 'exactly one' label
specification_gaps.gap: 'matches', 'separate' and the precedence among simultaneously applicable labels are not operationalized.
specification_gaps.executor_action: Pre-registered as OP-NULL, OP-SEP, OP-LABEL above, before any output, for Coordinator ratification.
